name: tallied
description: Time tracking and invoicing for freelancers and small teams, from your chat.

interface.shortDescription: Log hours and invoice clients from your AI chat
interface.longDescription:
Tell it what you worked on and it logs the hours to the right client. Ask what's unbilled and it drafts the invoice.

Forgot to track a day or a whole week? Tallied reconstructs it from your calendar events, git commits, and tickets, matches each item to a project, and asks before logging anything uncertain.

Ask how your week or month went and get hours by day, by project, or by client, billable vs. non-billable, and what's still unbilled. When it's time to get paid, Tallied drafts the invoice, shows you the lines and total before anything is created, and only sends it (with a Stripe payment link) once you say so. It can also close out a whole month across every client that owes hours, one invoice at a time, always with your approval before sending.

Already tracking time elsewhere? Import history from Toggl, Harvest, or Clockify to bring your record with you.

Nothing needed before connecting — a free account is created on connect.
